summary: Read-only verification of live production domain https://cardwizard.shop after Caddy SITE_ADDRESS fix and port 443 open. All 6 requested checks PASS. HTTPS root returns 200 with valid Let's Encrypt cert (issuer YE2, valid Oct 10 2026 - Jan 8 2027). www subdomain returns 200 with its own valid LE cert (YE1). HTTP to HTTPS 308 redirect works. /api/ returns {"message":"CardWizard API"}. /api/auth/captcha returns valid captcha JSON (captcha_id + question like '5 × 6 = ?'). Deep links /wallet and /login both return 200 (SPA served correctly, no 404). Browser render verified on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844) viewports — homepage shows MARKETPLACE hero, 8 products, verified vendors (NeonSoft Labs, Raj Verified) with proper layout. Login page renders captcha image + email/password form. Mobile view shows bottom nav bar correctly. No console errors.
test_credentials: Not used - read-only production checks only
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live production domain cardwizard.shop fully operational. TLS valid until Jan 8 2027. Both apex and www issued separate LE certs. SPA fallback working on deep refresh (/wallet /login return 200). Note: /wallet when unauthenticated renders the login page (expected auth-gated SPA behavior, not a 404). Captcha endpoint functional.
rca of the issue: Original issue: Caddy SITE_ADDRESS env var not applied and VPS cloud firewall blocked 443. User's own fixes (correcting SITE_ADDRESS so Caddy obtains cert, and opening port 443 in cloud firewall) have resolved both issues. External probes now get 200 + valid LE certificate.
